proposals.before: Your lordship has studied the Confucian learning and examined antiquity; you are honest, generous, and deeply sincere, and in establishing yourself and practicing the Way you have been consistent from beginning to end. Had you lived in the Master's time, you would surely have ascended Confucius's hall.
proposals.after: Lord Ming studied the Confucian learning and examined antiquity; he is honest, generous, and deeply sincere, and in establishing himself and practicing the Way he has been consistent from beginning to end. Had he lived in the Master's time, he would surely have ascended Confucius's hall.
proposals.reason: 明公 refers to Ming Shanbin (Lord Ming), not the addressee Xiao Gang; the letter eulogizes the deceased worthies.

proposals.before: He left office to mourn his mother; in observing mourning he exceeded the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming was concerned and personally wrote an admonition, saying, "Knowing your various virtues, your grief and prostration are excessive, and what you take in is scarcely not overflowing—this greatly pains me.
proposals.after: He left office to mourn his mother; in observing mourning he exceeded the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming was concerned and personally wrote an admonition, saying, "Knowing your various virtues, your grief and prostration are excessive, and what you take in is scarcely one yi—this greatly pains me.
proposals.reason: 殆無一溢 means intake is barely one yi (a small food measure), not 'scarcely not overflowing'.

proposals.before: At that time the administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and his elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.
proposals.after: At that time the administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and Xiang's elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.
proposals.reason: In a Lu Xiang biography, 兄子 without 其 after 遣黯及 normally means Xiang's elder brother's son, not Lu An's; the English "his" wrongly attaches to An.

proposals.after: At that time the Administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and Xiang's elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.

decisions.after: As a boy he impressed his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai, who often told his sons, "This child is the Wei Shu of your family."
decisions.reason: 陽元 is the courtesy name of the Western Jin statesman Wei Shu. Zhang Dai compares his gifted maternal grandson Lu Chui to that earlier exemplar; it is not an abstract yang force.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 魏舒，字陽元，任城樊人也。

decisions.after: In childhood he was regarded as extraordinary by his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai, who often told his sons, "This boy is the Yangyuan of your family."
decisions.reason: The literal field preserves Wei Shu's courtesy name Yangyuan while treating it as a personal allusion rather than translating it as 'yang origin.'

sourceWitness.excerpt: 魏舒，字陽元，任城樊人也。

decisions.after: Lord Ming was learned in the Confucian classics and versed in antiquity. He was honest, generous, and deeply sincere; in establishing himself and practicing the Way, he remained consistent from beginning to end. Had he lived in the Master's time, he would surely have entered Confucius's hall.
decisions.reason: The letter successively eulogizes Master Lu, Lord Ming, and Master Dao. 明公 is therefore Ming Shanbin in the third person, not a second-person address to Xiao Gang.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陸生資忠履貞...明公儒學稽古...到子風神開爽...皆海內之俊乂

decisions.after: He left office to mourn his mother and observed mourning beyond the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming, concerned for him, wrote an admonition in his own hand: "I know your many virtues, but your grief has brought you too low, and you take scarcely even one measure of food. This causes me deep distress.
decisions.reason: 一溢 is a small food measure, so the passage says Yin Jun was scarcely eating. The revision conveys the quantity without leaving an unexplained transliteration in the idiomatic field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 哀頓爲過，又所進殆無一溢...穀粥果蔬，少加勉強。

decisions.after: At the time, Xiao Ning, Administrator of Huainan and Marquis Wencheng, fled the rebels and entered Wu. Xiang welcomed him as leader of the alliance, then sent Lu An and Xiang's nephew Yinggong to lead the troops against Song Zixian.
decisions.reason: The continuing subject is Lu Xiang, so 兄子映公 is Xiang's elder brother's son. Using full names also makes the several actors easier to follow.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 襄遣迎寧爲盟主，遣黯及兄子映公帥衆拒子仙。

decisions.after: At that time Xiao Ning, Administrator of Huainan and Marquis Wencheng, fled the rebels and entered Wu. Xiang sent to receive Ning as leader of the alliance, then dispatched Lu An and Xiang's elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the troops against Song Zixian.
decisions.reason: The literal field must also attach 兄子 to the sentence's governing subject Lu Xiang rather than to the immediately preceding Lu An.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 襄遣迎寧爲盟主，遣黯及兄子映公帥衆拒子仙。

claimRevisions.reason: The allusion names Wei Shu by his courtesy name Yangyuan; the preferred person identity should therefore be Wei Shu rather than a fictitious man named Yang Yuan.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 魏舒，字陽元，任城樊人也。

claimRevisions.reason: Once the Yangyuan allusion is correctly identified as Wei Shu, his durable role can be recorded as an official rather than the placeholder 'named individual.'

sourceWitness.excerpt: 文帝深器重之...太康初，拜右僕射。

sourceDate.text: Allusion to Wei Shu, courtesy name Yangyuan; Jinshu 41 records his death in AD 290 at age 82

claimRevisions.reason: The old interval belongs to Lu Chui's childhood, not to the earlier statesman being invoked. Wei Shu died in AD 290 aged eighty-two, yielding a conventional lifespan of AD 209-290.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太熙元年薨，時年八十二。

claimAdditions.reason: The chapter identifies Wei Shu through his courtesy name Yangyuan, which must remain searchable as an alias after the preferred identity is corrected.
